item.description: Stock Yards Bancorp Inc., parent company of Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co., announced it will acquire Field & Main Bancorp Inc. in an all-stock transaction expected to close during the second quarter of 2026.

item.description: Blue Grass Airport (LEX) announced that Delta Air Lines will add a second daily nonstop flight between Lexington and New York’s LaGuardia Airport beginning June 7.

item.title: New KDA Report Underscores Bourbon’s Significant Role in Kentucky’s Economy
